identity.title: Victini and the Black Hero: Zekrom / Victini and the White Hero: Reshiram Music Collections

leadText: Victini and the Black Hero: Zekrom Music Collection and Victini and the White Hero: Reshiram Music Collection are the Japanese soundtracks for the double-feature film collectively known as Theatrical Version - Pocket Monsters Best Wishes!: The First Movie. The films have separate soundtracks that were released together in two discs. They were released in Japan on July 27, 2011.
plainText:
Victini and the Black Hero: Zekrom Music Collection and Victini and the White Hero: Reshiram Music Collection are the Japanese soundtracks for the double-feature film collectively known as Theatrical Version - Pocket Monsters Best Wishes!: The First Movie. The films have separate soundtracks that were released together in two discs. They were released in Japan on July 27, 2011.

==Tracklist==
===CD 1===
The first CD serves as the soundtrack for Black Hero.
